account: Barking, Havering and Redbridge University Hospitals NHS Trust
headline:
Taking the manual work off
your first line
subhead: How Xurrent handles the password resets, leaver processing and reporting your team does by hand today.
flow_heading: How a leaver moves through Xurrent
mirror: You are running Ivanti Neurons v22 with no AI and no automation, so the team resolves hundreds of tickets a day by hand. Password resets are 30 to 40% of everything that comes in. Your team leader worked out that a leaver takes three minutes, and a batch of 135 works out at six and three quarter hours per analyst on top of the day job. Reporting comes out to Excel and gets tidied in PowerPoint, which you put at around 10 years behind where you want to be.

flow.d: The HR feed lands in Xurrent as a workflow rather than an email attachment. No one rekeys the names.

flow.t: Tasks reach each team at once
flow.d: Desktop collects the device, Systems removes drive and group access, IT Security closes its own checks. Each is a task with an owner, not a chase.
Your team leaders see where a leaver has stalled without opening four systems. So do the teams doing the work.
The workflow completes only when every task does. The device return step stops being a goodwill exercise.

stack.how: Documented integration. Named as a live integration on two published Xurrent customer pages, Claraspital and NAFTA. Your SE will confirm the connector against your version before you rely on it.
Identity integration is standard across published Xurrent deployments, including Active Directory and Azure AD. Confirm the Entra specifics with your SE.
No documented connector. The honest path is a scheduled feed into the joiner and leaver workflow rather than a prebuilt app. Needs SE scoping.
Xurrent has a CTI framework that covers a range of telephony systems. Whether it reaches your physical exchange is an SE question, not a claim we will make here.
Reporting can be read from Xurrent directly or pushed to a central BI tool. Worth scoping how much of your Qlik work stops being necessary at all.

items.d: The portal carries the reset journey rather than pointing at a form nobody opens.
Triages what arrives, answers from your own knowledge base, and logs the rest to the right team.
The same knowledge is available at 11pm without extending the desk to cover it.
One tap from an affected user raises a linked ticket, so an outage does not become 40 calls.
Your managers open their own numbers instead of asking you at nine for a report by three.
The Monday open and closed report goes out without anyone building it.
Your outsourced network provider appears in the same reporting as everyone else.

proof.d: UK healthcare, around 1,000 specialists. Live in 90 days from signature, moving off ServiceNow after evaluating Ivanti.
Open tickets fell from an average of 5,000 to closer to 400. Also evaluated Ivanti before choosing Xurrent.
43% of IT requests automated. Self-service went from under 5% of requests to 32%.

next_step: Kyle will send the technical specification list for your tender, plus the business case template, before you brief procurement. No meeting needed to receive either.
